verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.mixpanel.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as markdown links. Many doc pages are served as .md, and dedicated MCP documentation gives agents a machine-oriented entry point. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404), evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use these docs effectively.
